disclaimer: Indicative reference data, not tax advice. Figures reflect HMRC appropriate-percentage policy announced to 2029/30 and the Autumn Budget 2025 eVED measure. Verify against HMRC guidance before relying on these figures.
description: Company car tax appropriate percentages by fuel type and tax year. The percentage is applied to the vehicle P11D value to give the taxable benefit.

zeroEmission.description: Battery electric vehicles. Selected by fuel type, never by CO2 = 0, so a zero-CO2 PHEV does not fall into this schedule.

plugInHybrid.description: 1 to 50 g/km. Banded by electric-only range to 2027/28, then reset to a single flat rate.
plugInHybrid.note: From 2028/29 the electric-range banding no longer applies: all 1-50 g/km vehicles take 18% (2028/29) then 19% (2029/30).

internalCombustion.description: 51 g/km and above, petrol and diesel. Base table frozen to 2027/28, then +1 percentage point per year.

dieselSurcharge.appliesTo: Diesel vehicles not certified to RDE2
dieselSurcharge.note: Applied to the base percentage before the yearly uplift, and subject to the same cap.
